query:
UPDATE hardening_scans
        SET
            status = $1,
            completed_at = NOW(),
            total_services = $2,
            well_hardened_count = $3,
            moderately_hardened_count = $4,
            poorly_hardened_count = $5,
            vulnerable_count = $6,
            overall_score = $7,
            scan_duration_ms = $8
        WHERE id = $9
